title: Divisibility tests and prime factorization
competency: Use divisibility tests to check division quickly, and write any composite number as a product of primes.

keywords.def: A quick rule that tells whether a number divides another without doing the division.
Writing a number as a product of primes, for example 72 = 2³ × 3².
A diagram that splits a number into factors, again and again, until every factor is prime.
Every composite number can be written as a product of primes in exactly one way, apart from the order.

en.text: A divisibility test tells you if a number divides another, without dividing. For 2, 5 and 10, look at the last digit. For 4, look at the last two digits. For 8, the last three. For 3 and 9, add the digits. For 6, test both 2 and 3.

am.text: የመካፈል ፈተና አንድ ቁጥር ሌላውን ያለ ቀሪ እንደሚካፍል ሳታካፍል ይነግርሃል። ለ2፣ 5 እና 10 የመጨረሻውን አሃዝ ተመልከት። ለ4 የመጨረሻዎቹን ሁለት አሃዞች፣ ለ8 የመጨረሻዎቹን ሦስት ተመልከት። ለ3 እና 9 አሃዞቹን ደምር። ለ6 በ2 እና በ3 ፈትን።

screens.title: Books for nine classes
screens.text: A school in Bahir Dar has 765 exercise books. It wants to give 9 classes equal shares, with none left.
screens.ask: Is that possible? Guess without dividing.
screens.after: Yes! 7 + 6 + 5 = 18, and 18 is divisible by 9. Read on to see why that works.

screens.title: Divisibility tests
paras: A divisibility test tells you if a number is divisible by 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 or 10.
You do not need to do the division.
screens.note: A test for 7 exists, but it is beyond this level.

screens.title: The tests
paras: A number is divisible by the number on the left when the test is true.
table: The sum of the digits is divisible by 3
The number formed by the last two digits is divisible by 4
It is divisible by both 2 and 3
The number formed by the last three digits is divisible by 8
The sum of the digits is divisible by 9

screens.title: A quick rule
defs: A quick rule that tells whether a number divides another, without dividing.

screens.title: Test for 4
opts: No, because it does not end in 4
screens.why: For 4, only the last two digits matter: 12 ÷ 4 = 3.
screens.clue: Which digits does the test for 4 look at?

steps: It ends in 4, so it is divisible by 2.
2 + 3 + 3 + 4 = 12, so it is divisible by 3.
It is divisible by 2 and 3, so it is divisible by 6.
The last two digits make 34. Not divisible by 4.
It ends in 4, not 0 or 5. Not divisible by 5 or 10.
The last three digits make 334. Not divisible by 8.
The digit sum 12 is not divisible by 9. Not divisible by 9.

screens.title: Two tests at once
screens.text: A number is divisible by 2 and by 3. What else must it be divisible by?
screens.why: Divisible by 2 and 3 is exactly the test for 6.
screens.clue: Read the row for 6 in the table.

screens.title: Remainder and divisibility
screens.why: The remainder is 4, not 0. The test agrees: 2,334 does not end in 0 or 5.
screens.clue: When is a number divisible by another?

screens.title: Find the digit
screens.text: 52x is a three-digit number. x is its units digit.
screens.ask: The smallest digit x that makes 52x divisible by 3 is ___.
screens.why: 5 + 2 + 2 = 9, which is divisible by 3. So 522 works.
screens.clue: 5 + 2 = 7. What is the smallest digit you can add to reach a multiple of 3?
screens.worked: 5 + 2 = 7. Try x = 0: 7. x = 1: 8. x = 2: 9, a multiple of 3. So x = 2.

screens.title: Sharing birr
screens.text: A farmer in Bishoftu shares 1,236 birr equally among his 4 children.
screens.ask: Will any birr be left over?
opts: Yes, because 1,236 is not divisible by 4
screens.why: The last two digits make 36, and 36 ÷ 4 = 9. So 1,236 is divisible by 4.
screens.clue: Which digits does the test for 4 use?

en.text: Prime factorization writes a number as a product of primes. Split the number into two factors. Keep splitting any factor that is not prime. Stop when every factor is prime. For example, 72 = 2³ × 3². Every composite number has only one prime factorization, apart from order.

am.text: የብቸኛ ቁጥሮች ውጤት አንድን ቁጥር የብቸኛ ቁጥሮች ብዜት አድርጎ ይጽፋል። ቁጥሩን ለሁለት አካፋዮች ክፈል። ብቸኛ ያልሆነውን አካፋይ መከፋፈል ቀጥል። ሁሉም አካፋዮች ብቸኛ ሲሆኑ አቁም። ለምሳሌ 72 = 2³ × 3²። ማንኛውም ተዋሃጅ ቁጥር ከቅደም ተከተል በስተቀር አንድ ብቻ የብቸኛ ቁጥሮች ውጤት አለው።

screens.title: Two ways to start
screens.text: Kebede starts with 72 = 8 × 9. Tigist starts with 72 = 2 × 36. Both keep splitting until only primes are left.
screens.ask: Will they end with the same primes?
screens.after: Both end with 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3. Read on to see why this always happens.

screens.title: Prime factorization
paras: Definition 1.2: writing a number as a product of prime numbers is called prime factorization.
To factorize a composite number, split it into two factors.
If a factor is still composite, split it again.
Stop when every factor is prime.

screens.title: Products of primes
defs: Writing a number as a product of primes, for example 72 = 2³ × 3².
A diagram of the splits, ending when every factor is prime.

screens.title: Factorize 60
screens.text: What is the prime factorization of 60?
screens.clue: Are all the factors prime? Check 30, 4, 15 and 10.

screens.title: Examples
screens.text: Split until every factor is prime.
steps: A factor tree shows these splits.

screens.title: A division ladder
screens.text: Divide by the smallest prime that works, until you reach a prime.
steps: 57 ÷ 3 = 19, and 19 is prime.

screens.title: Theorem 1.2
paras: Every composite number can be written as a product of primes.
This factorization is unique, apart from the order of the factors.
This is the fundamental theorem of arithmetic.

screens.title: Only one answer
defs: Every composite number is a product of primes in exactly one way, apart from order.

screens.title: Two students, one answer
screens.text: Two students factorize 84 in different orders. What does the fundamental theorem say about their answers?
opts: They get the same primes, maybe in a different order
Only the first student can be right
screens.ans: They get the same primes, maybe in a different order
screens.why: The prime factorization is unique apart from order.

screens.title: True or false?
screens.why: 4 is not prime. The prime factorization is 2² × 3 × 7.

screens.title: Missing prime
screens.clue: Multiply 2 × 3² first. Then divide 90 by it.

screens.title: A box of oranges
screens.text: A trader in Hawassa packs 42 oranges in a box. The rows, columns and layers are each a prime number.
screens.clue: Write 42 as a product of primes.

items.text: Test 384 for 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10. It is divisible by:
items.why: Even; digit sum 15; 84 ÷ 4 = 21; 384 ÷ 8 = 48. Digit sum 15 is not divisible by 9.

items.text: Test 3,186 for 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10. It is divisible by:
items.why: Even, and digit sum 18. 86 is not divisible by 4, and 186 not by 8.

items.text: 74,3x2 is divisible by 4, where x is the tens digit. What can x be?
items.clue: Only the last two digits, x2, matter. Try x = 0 and x = 1.

items.ask: The smallest digit for the blank is ___.
items.why: The last two digits are 40, divisible by 4 whatever the blank is.

screens.title: Divide with a remainder
steps: Find the biggest multiple of 4 not above 38: 4 × 9 = 36.
38 − 36 = 2 is left over.
So 38 = (4 × 9) + 2. The quotient is 9, the remainder 2.
When the remainder is 0, the number is divisible.
